description: Test suite for the usage-accumulator module, verifying functions that create, merge, normalize, and resolve usage data related to resource tracking in a software project.

methods.name: mergeUsageIntoAccumulator
methods.description: Merges usage data into an accumulator object, updating totals and last call snapshot.

methods.name: createUsageAccumulator
methods.description: Creates a new, empty usage accumulator object.

methods.name: toNormalizedUsage
methods.description: Returns a normalized usage snapshot suitable for billing, omitting zero fields.

methods.name: toLastCallUsage
methods.description: Returns the final call's usage snapshot from the accumulator.

methods.name: resolveLastCallUsage
methods.description: Resolves the last call usage, preferring raw assistant data if valid.
